name: Carpinienne de Participations
summary: Carpinienne de Participations engages in the equity management business. It also holds 5.14% interests in Foncière Euris, which has a property portfolio that primarily consists of shopping malls. The company was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Paris, France. Carpinienne de Participations is a subsidiary of Finatis Société Anonyme.
